EO10704 contains exactly paragraph 1's membership direction and paragraph 2's conforming parent-section-1 amendment. It inserts Defense in place of Attorney General in EO10673's original composition; Vice President remains chair. No target report obligation, deadline, sunset, contingent completion, transferred property, separate delegation or savings provision occurs. Hereafter supports operation from March 25, 1957; March 27 publication is separate.

EO10740 paragraph 1 removes Vice President and makes Interior chair; paragraph 2 further amends parent section 1. EO10785 paragraphs 1-2 add Commerce and Housing/Home Finance while retaining Interior chair. They are membership amendments, not first cessation, under the owner strike-and-insert ruling. The candidates preserve the before/after text and disclose the substantive change. Neither amendment includes delayed commencement.

EO10931 section 1 separately rewrites parent membership; section 2 expressly revokes EO10704, EO10740 and EO10785 by number and date. Hereby revocation and March 29, 1961 signature/filing support immediate named whole-order revocation. No partial scope, delayed effect or old-target savings appears. This directly ends both EO10704 paragraphs; it does not end the Council institution.

EO10673 sections 2-7 supply independent parent functions, agency assistance, advisory arrangements, annual meetings/reports and statutory-function savings. EO10704 amends only section 1 and does not reenact those independent duties as its own. EO10772 changes only parent section 4; no target termination or revival.

EO11074 section 3(a) preserves independent agency functions, section 4 expressly continues the Council institution, and section 6 revokes EO10673/10772/10931. It never restores EO10704 or its superseded membership. Institutional continuation is disclosed and does not preserve target command authority. Historical factual consequences or independent liabilities are not pronounced extinguished.
